verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork product page says its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence from connected enterprise systems on a schedule, using APIs and browser workflows. Integration docs (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace) back up the connected-system monitoring. However, the evidence comes only from marketing pages, and nothing documents timestamped artifacts or shows that screenshots and CSV exports are actually replaced (browser workflows may still produce screenshots). missing for 10: documentation of timestamped, machine-gathered artifact format, confirmation that screenshots/CSV exports are eliminated, schedule configuration details in docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Fieldwork’s AI agents gather and package evidence across your systems on schedule.
Fieldwork uses APIs and browser workflows to access evidence from your connectors.
Oneleet maps your external infrastructure, identifies risks, and generates SOC 2 evidence, continuously.
